content: Our model follows the encoder-decoder architecture BIBREF14. Because our contribution focuses on the encoding process, we chose the decoding module used in BIBREF12, BIBREF10: a two-layers LSTM network with a copy mechanism. In order to supervise this mechanism, we assume that each record value that also appears in the target is copied from the data-structure and we train the model to switch between freely generating words from the vocabulary and copying words from the input. We now describe the hierarchical encoder and the hierarchical attention.
